_comment: Explanations of FBR DI error codes in our own words. Sales codes: spec v1.12 §7. Purchase codes: §8 (purchase invoices are outside DI Doctor's validation scope; explanations only). Technical guidance, not tax advice.

0001.title: Seller is not registered for sales tax
0001.meaning: FBR looked up the seller's number and found no active sales tax registration.
commonCauses: Seller number belongs to an income-tax-only taxpayer
Registration suspended or not yet active
Sandbox token issued for a different test seller
0001.fix: Confirm the seller's sales tax registration status on the FBR portal (the STATL reference API also reports it) and use the registered number.

0002.title: Buyer NTN/CNIC has the wrong format
0002.meaning: FBR could not read the buyer's registration number as either an NTN or a CNIC.
commonCauses: Spaces, dashes or letters inside the number
Wrong length (the spec mentions 7-digit NTN, 13-digit CNIC, and in one place a 9-digit NTN)
Sending the number as a JSON number so leading zeros are lost
0002.fix: Send the number as a string of digits only, with no separators, and keep any leading zeros.

0003.title: Invoice type is not recognised
0003.meaning: invoiceType was sent but is not one of the values FBR accepts.
commonCauses: Using "Sales Invoice" (the spec table's spelling) instead of "Sale Invoice" (the samples' spelling)
Lower-case or extra whitespace
Using an invoice type from another system, such as Credit Note

0005.title: Invoice date is in the wrong format
0005.meaning: FBR could not parse the invoice date. The spec is inconsistent on the format, but the samples and the brief message use YYYY-MM-DD.
commonCauses: Date sent as DD-MM-YYYY or DD-MMM-YYYY
Date sent with a time part
Locale-formatted date from the ERP
0005.fix: Send invoiceDate as a plain YYYY-MM-DD string, for example 2025-05-25.

0006.title: No sale invoice exists for this withholding entry
0006.meaning: FBR expected an existing sale invoice to attach a sales-tax-withholding record to and found none.
commonCauses: Withholding declared before the original invoice was accepted
Wrong reference number
0006.fix: Make sure the original sale invoice was accepted by FBR first and reference its FBR invoice number. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0007.title: Sale type does not fit this invoice
0007.meaning: The sale type you chose is not allowed for this seller's registration or for the scenario being tested.
commonCauses: In sandbox: saleType does not match the sale type the scenario expects
Sale type reserved for a sector you are not registered in (for example steel or textile)
Different casing or spelling from the official sale type list
0007.fix: Copy the sale type exactly from the scenario table and make sure it fits the seller's business activity. Run `di-doctor scenarios` to see the expected sale type for each scenario.

0008.title: Sales tax withheld at source has an unexpected value
0008.meaning: The amount withheld at source must be either zero or exactly equal to the sales tax amount on the line.
commonCauses: Withholding a partial amount
Rounding differences between the two fields
Copying furtherTax or extraTax into the withheld field by mistake
0008.fix: Set salesTaxWithheldAtSource to 0, or make it identical to salesTaxApplicable for that line.

0009.title: Buyer registration number is missing
0009.meaning: buyerNTNCNIC is empty but FBR needed it, usually because the buyer is marked as Registered.
commonCauses: buyerRegistrationType is "Registered" but the number was left blank
Field dropped by the ERP for walk-in customers
0009.fix: Provide the buyer's NTN or CNIC, or mark the buyer as Unregistered if that is the case.

0010.title: Buyer business name is missing
commonCauses: Walk-in sale without a customer record
Field mapped from an empty ERP column
0010.fix: Send a non-empty buyer name on every invoice, including sales to unregistered buyers.

0011.title: Invoice type is missing
commonCauses: Field not mapped
Sent as null

0012.title: Buyer registration type is missing
commonCauses: Key misspelled as "buyeRegistrationType" (the typo in the spec's field table)
Field not mapped
0012.fix: Send buyerRegistrationType as "Registered" or "Unregistered". Check the key spelling.

0013.title: Sale type is missing or not recognised
0013.meaning: FBR did not receive a usable sale type for at least one line item.
commonCauses: saleType is empty or null
Typo or extra whitespace in the sale type
Using a value that is not in FBR's transaction type list
0013.fix: Send one of FBR's official sale type strings on every item. The sandbox scenario table lists the expected sale type for each scenario.

0018.title: Sales tax (or FED in sales-tax mode) is missing
0018.meaning: salesTaxApplicable is empty on a line item.
commonCauses: Field sent as null or an empty string
Zero-rated line sent without an explicit 0
0018.fix: Send salesTaxApplicable as a number on every item; use 0 for zero-rated or exempt lines.

0019.title: HS code is missing
0019.meaning: At least one line item has no HS code.
commonCauses: hsCode empty, null or absent
Product master data has no HS code mapped
0019.fix: Send the HS code for every item, in the form FBR uses in its item list (for example 0101.2100).

0020.title: Rate is missing
0020.meaning: rate is empty on a line item.
commonCauses: Field sent as null, empty string, or a number instead of a string
0020.fix: Send rate as a string exactly as FBR's rate list spells it, for example "18%".

0021.title: Value excluding sales tax or quantity is missing
0021.meaning: valueSalesExcludingST or quantity is empty on a line item.
commonCauses: Fields sent as null or empty strings
Service lines sent without a quantity
0021.fix: Send both as JSON numbers on every item; use 1 for quantity when it does not apply.

0022.title: Sales tax withheld at source is missing
0022.meaning: salesTaxWithheldAtSource is empty on a line item.
commonCauses: Optional-looking field left out
Sent as null
0022.fix: Send salesTaxWithheldAtSource on every item; use 0 when nothing is withheld.

0023.title: Sales tax is missing
0023.meaning: The sales tax amount for a line was not provided.
commonCauses: Sent as null or an empty string
0023.fix: Send salesTaxApplicable as a number, 0 if none applies.

0024.title: Sales tax withheld is missing
0024.meaning: A withheld-tax amount FBR expected was not provided.
commonCauses: Withholding-agent invoice without the withheld amount
0024.fix: Send the withheld amount as a number, 0 if none. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0026.title: Reference invoice number is required for a debit note
0026.meaning: A debit note must point to the original invoice it adjusts, and that reference is missing.
commonCauses: invoiceRefNo left empty when invoiceType is Debit Note
Using your internal invoice number instead of the FBR-issued one
0026.fix: Put the FBR invoice number of the original invoice in invoiceRefNo. The spec says it is 22 characters for NTN-based sellers and 28 for CNIC-based sellers.

0027.title: Reason is required for a debit or credit note
0027.meaning: FBR expected a reason for the note.
commonCauses: Note submitted through a channel that requires a reason field
0027.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0028.title: Reason remarks are required
0028.meaning: The note's reason was set to "Others" without free-text remarks.
commonCauses: Reason "Others" chosen without explanation
0028.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0029.title: Note date is earlier than the original invoice
0029.meaning: A debit or credit note must be dated on or after the original invoice.
commonCauses: Back-dated note
Original invoice re-issued with a later date
0029.fix: Use a note date on or after the date of the invoice referenced in invoiceRefNo.

0030.title: Unregistered distributor type not allowed before the cut-off date
0030.meaning: FBR rejects this buyer type for dates before a system-wide cut-off.
commonCauses: Invoice dated before the rule change
0030.fix: Check the invoice date and the buyer type. The cut-off date is set by FBR, not documented in the spec.

0031.title: Sales tax is not mentioned
0031.meaning: The sales tax amount is absent.
commonCauses: Sent as null
0031.fix: Send salesTaxApplicable as a number on every item.

0032.title: Withholding record only allowed for government or FTN holders
0032.meaning: A sales-tax-withholding entry without a sale invoice is only accepted from government or free-tax-number holders.
commonCauses: Normal taxpayer trying to declare withholding without the underlying invoice
0032.fix: Declare the sale invoice first; withholding-only entries are reserved for government/FTN holders. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0034.title: Note submitted too long after the original invoice
0034.meaning: Debit and credit notes are only accepted within 180 days of the original invoice date.
commonCauses: Late adjustment
0034.fix: Issue the note within the 180-day window. For older invoices, ask your tax adviser about the correct process.

0035.title: Note date must not precede the original invoice
0035.meaning: Same check as 0029: the note's date must be on or after the original invoice date.
commonCauses: Back-dated note
0035.fix: Use a note date on or after the original invoice date.

0036.title: Credit note value exceeds the original
0036.meaning: The total value across credit notes for an invoice cannot be more than the original invoice's value.
commonCauses: Multiple credit notes against one invoice adding up beyond its value
Wrong reference invoice
0036.fix: Check the cumulative credit notes against the original invoice value.

0037.title: Credit note withheld tax exceeds the original
0037.meaning: The sales tax withheld on credit notes cannot exceed the amount withheld on the original invoice.
commonCauses: Withheld amount copied from a different invoice
0037.fix: Keep the withheld amount at or below the original invoice's withheld amount.

0039.title: Withholding invoice fields differ from the sale invoice
0039.meaning: For registered buyers, a withholding entry must repeat the fields of the sale invoice it belongs to.
commonCauses: Values edited between the sale invoice and the withholding entry
0039.fix: Copy the original invoice fields unchanged. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0041.title: Invoice number is missing
0041.meaning: An invoice number FBR expected was empty.
commonCauses: Channel that requires the seller's own invoice number
0041.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0042.title: Invoice date is missing
commonCauses: Field not mapped
Sent as null

0043.title: Invoice date is not valid
0043.meaning: invoiceDate parsed but is not an acceptable date.
commonCauses: Impossible date such as 2025-02-30
Date far in the future or past
0043.fix: Send a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD.

0044.title: HS code is missing
0044.meaning: At least one line item has no HS code.
commonCauses: hsCode is empty, null or absent
Product master data has no HS code mapped
0044.fix: Send the HS code for every item in the format FBR uses in its item list, for example 0101.2100.

0046.title: Rate is missing
0046.meaning: At least one line item has no tax rate, or the rate does not fit the chosen sale type.
commonCauses: rate is empty or null
Rate sent as a number (18) instead of the string FBR expects ("18%")
Rate string does not match any rate FBR lists for that sale type
0046.fix: Send rate as a string, exactly as FBR's rate list spells it for the sale type you chose.

0050.title: Cotton ginners: withheld tax must equal the sales tax or be zero
0050.meaning: For the Cotton Ginners sale type the withheld amount has only two valid values.
commonCauses: Partial withholding
0050.fix: Set salesTaxWithheldAtSource to 0 or to the full salesTaxApplicable.

0052.title: HS code does not fit the sale type
0052.meaning: The HS code on a line item is not allowed together with the sale type on that same line. This is one of the most common errors.
commonCauses: Using a generic HS code with a sector-specific sale type (steel, petroleum, telecom and so on)
Correct HS code but wrong sale type for the scenario
HS code not present in FBR's item list
0052.fix: Check that the HS code exists in FBR's item list and that the sale type is one FBR allows for that code. DI Doctor cannot verify this pairing offline because it needs FBR's reference APIs.

0053.title: Buyer registration type is not recognised
0053.meaning: buyerRegistrationType has a value other than the two FBR accepts.
commonCauses: Lower-case "registered"
Values like "Yes"/"No" or "Consumer"

0055.title: Sales tax withheld as withholding agent is missing or malformed
0055.meaning: A withholding-agent amount was expected and was empty or not a number.
commonCauses: Field absent on a withholding-agent invoice
0055.fix: Send the withheld amount as a number. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0056.title: Buyer is not in the steel sector
0056.meaning: Steel-sector sale types require the buyer to be registered in FBR's steel sector list.
commonCauses: Selling steel sale types to a buyer outside the sector
Test buyer not set up for steel in sandbox
0056.fix: Use a buyer registered in the steel sector, or a different sale type.

0057.title: Referenced invoice does not exist
0057.meaning: invoiceRefNo does not match any invoice FBR has on record.
commonCauses: Using your internal number instead of the FBR-issued one
Original invoice sent to the other environment (sandbox vs production)
Typo in the reference
0057.fix: Copy the FBR invoice number exactly as it came back in the original response.

0058.title: Seller and buyer are the same
0058.meaning: The seller's and the buyer's registration numbers are identical. FBR does not accept an invoice to yourself.
commonCauses: Test data reusing the same NTN for both parties
Buyer field defaulted to the seller's own number
0058.fix: Use a different buyer registration number.

0064.title: A credit note already exists for this invoice
0064.meaning: Only one credit note can be attached to an invoice.
commonCauses: Retrying a credit note that was already accepted
0064.fix: Check the original invoice's status before sending another note.

0067.title: Debit note sales tax exceeds the original
0067.meaning: The sales tax on a debit note cannot be more than the original invoice's sales tax.
commonCauses: Wrong reference invoice
Tax computed on the wrong base
0067.fix: Keep the debit note's tax at or below the original invoice's tax.

0068.title: Credit note sales tax is below what the rate implies
0068.meaning: The credit note's sales tax is less than the original invoice's tax computed for the rate.
commonCauses: Partial credit with tax not recomputed
0068.fix: Recompute the credit note's tax from its value and rate.

0070.title: Withholding not allowed for unregistered buyers
0070.meaning: Sales tax withholding entries are only accepted when the buyer is registered.
commonCauses: buyerRegistrationType Unregistered with a non-zero withheld amount
0070.fix: Set salesTaxWithheldAtSource to 0 for unregistered buyers.

0071.title: Credit note not allowed for this user
0071.meaning: Only certain taxpayers may add credit notes against a declared invoice.
commonCauses: Taxpayer category not permitted to issue credit notes through this channel
0071.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0073.title: Sale origination province of the supplier is missing
0073.meaning: FBR expected the province where the supply originates.
commonCauses: Province field empty
0073.fix: Send sellerProvince using a name from the province reference API. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0074.title: Destination of supply is missing
commonCauses: Province field empty
0074.fix: Send buyerProvince using a name from the province reference API. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0077.title: SRO or schedule number is missing
0077.meaning: The sale type or rate requires an SRO/schedule reference and none was given.
commonCauses: Reduced-rate, exempt or SRO-based sale type without sroScheduleNo
0077.fix: Fill sroScheduleNo with the schedule that grants the rate (see the SRO schedule reference API).

0078.title: SRO item serial number is missing
0078.meaning: FBR expected an item serial number from the SRO schedule but none was provided.
commonCauses: sroScheduleNo filled in but sroItemSerialNo left empty
Reduced-rate or exempt sale type that requires an SRO reference
0078.fix: When a line references an SRO schedule, also send the item serial number from that schedule. FBR's SRO item reference API lists the valid values.

0079.title: 5% rate not allowed above the value limit
0079.meaning: The reduced 5% rate cannot be used when the line's value excluding sales tax is above 20,000.
commonCauses: Reduced-rate scenario tested with a large line value
0079.fix: Lower the line value below the limit or use the rate that applies above it. Which rate applies is a tax question, not something DI Doctor can decide.

0080.title: Further tax is missing
0080.meaning: FBR expected a further-tax amount and found none.
commonCauses: Sale to an unregistered buyer where further tax applies, field left null
0080.fix: Send furtherTax as a number (0 when it does not apply). Whether it applies is a tax question.

0081.title: "Input credit not allowed" flag is missing
0081.meaning: A field from FBR's wider return system was expected.
commonCauses: Channel other than the DI API
0081.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0082.title: Seller is not registered for sales tax
0082.meaning: Same meaning as 0001: the seller has no active sales tax registration.
commonCauses: Income-tax-only seller
Suspended registration
0082.fix: Use a seller number with active sales tax registration.

0083.title: Seller registration number does not match
0083.meaning: The seller number in the payload is not the one FBR associates with your access.
commonCauses: Token issued for a different NTN
Group company using one token for several sellers
0083.fix: Use the seller number the token was issued for, or request a token for this seller.

0085.title: Total value of sales is missing (PFAD only)
0085.meaning: A total value is required for this particular sale category.
commonCauses: totalValues left at 0 for a PFAD sale
0085.fix: Provide totalValues for this category. The spec does not define PFAD; ask PRAL if you are unsure.

0086.title: Not an EFS licence holder who imported compressor scrap
0086.meaning: A sale type restricted to Export Facilitation Scheme licence holders with qualifying imports in the last 12 months.
commonCauses: Sale type chosen for a taxpayer without the licence or the import history
0086.fix: Use a different sale type unless your business holds the licence and has the imports.

0087.title: Petroleum levy rates are not configured
0087.meaning: FBR's petroleum levy rates were not available for this sale.
commonCauses: Petroleum sale type while FBR's rate table is incomplete for the date
0087.fix: This is on FBR's side; retry later or contact PRAL.

0088.title: Invoice number format is not accepted
0088.meaning: Invoice numbers may contain letters, digits and dashes, with dashes only between characters.
commonCauses: Leading or trailing dash
Slashes, spaces or other symbols
0088.fix: Use a format like INV-001. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0089.title: FED charged is missing
0089.meaning: A federal excise duty amount was expected.
commonCauses: FED-in-sales-tax-mode sale type with fedPayable left null
0089.fix: Send fedPayable as a number for FED-related sale types.

0090.title: Fixed/notified value or retail price is missing
commonCauses: Field sent as null instead of 0
0090.fix: Send it as a number on every item; use 0 when it does not apply.

0091.title: Extra tax must be empty
0091.meaning: FBR rejected a non-zero extraTax for this kind of sale. The spec does not say which sale types allow extra tax.
commonCauses: extraTax filled in on a sale type that does not support it
ERP copying furtherTax into extraTax
0091.fix: Send extraTax as 0 (or omit it) unless you know this sale type requires it.

0092.title: Purchase type is missing or invalid
0092.meaning: A purchase-side sale type was expected.
commonCauses: Purchase invoice channel
0092.fix: Send a valid type. This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0093.title: Sale type not allowed for manufacturers
0093.meaning: The chosen sale type is reserved for other business activities.
commonCauses: Manufacturer using a distribution- or retail-only sale type
0093.fix: Pick a sale type that matches the seller's business activity. `di-doctor scenarios` lists the scenarios (and sale types) per activity.

0095.title: Extra tax is missing
0095.meaning: extraTax was expected for this sale and was empty.
commonCauses: Sale type that requires extra tax, field left null
0095.fix: Send extraTax as a number (0 when none applies).

0096.title: Only the KWH unit is allowed for this HS code
0096.meaning: Electricity HS codes must use KWH as the unit of measure.
commonCauses: ERP default unit used for electricity lines
0096.fix: Set uoM to the KWH description from FBR's UOM list.

0097.title: Unit of measure must be KG
0097.meaning: This HS code must be reported by weight.
commonCauses: Pieces or units used for a weight-based product
0097.fix: Set uoM to KG as spelled in FBR's UOM list.

0098.title: Quantity or electricity units are missing
0098.meaning: quantity is empty on a line that requires it.
commonCauses: Electricity supply line without units

0099.title: Unit of measure does not fit the HS code
0099.meaning: The UOM on a line item is not one FBR allows for that HS code.
commonCauses: Using your ERP's own unit names instead of FBR's list
HS code that requires a specific unit (for example KG or KWH)
0099.fix: Look up the allowed units for the HS code with FBR's HS-to-UOM reference API and copy the description exactly.

0100.title: Cotton ginners sale type requires a registered buyer
0100.meaning: The Cotton Ginners type is only accepted when the buyer is registered.
commonCauses: Unregistered buyer on a cotton ginner purchase
0100.fix: Use a registered buyer, or a different sale type.

0101.title: Steel sector must use the Toll Manufacturing sale type
0101.meaning: For this steel-sector transaction FBR expects Toll Manufacturing.
commonCauses: Steel melting/re-rolling type chosen where toll manufacturing applies
0101.fix: Switch the sale type to Toll Manufacturing for this transaction.

0102.title: Third Schedule tax calculation does not match
0102.meaning: FBR recomputed the tax with its Third Schedule formula (retail-price based) and got a different number.
commonCauses: Tax computed on the sale value instead of the retail price
Retail price missing or zero
0102.fix: Compute tax on fixedNotifiedValueOrRetailPrice for Third Schedule goods. The exact formula is not in the spec.

0103.title: Potassium chlorate tax calculation does not match
0103.meaning: FBR applies a quantity-based formula for potassium chlorate and your amount differs.
commonCauses: Tax computed as a plain percentage
0103.fix: Compute the tax per the potassium chlorate rule (quantity-based). The formula is not in the spec; ask your tax adviser.

0104.title: Sales tax amount does not match the rate
0104.meaning: FBR recomputed salesTaxApplicable from valueSalesExcludingST and the rate, and the numbers do not agree.
commonCauses: Tax computed on a discounted or inclusive value while the rate applies to valueSalesExcludingST
Rounding at invoice level instead of line level
Rate string and the amount come from different sources
0104.fix: Recalculate salesTaxApplicable per line as valueSalesExcludingST multiplied by the percentage in rate, rounded to two decimals.

0105.title: Quantity-based tax is incorrect
0105.meaning: For sale types taxed per unit, the tax does not match quantity times the per-unit amount.
commonCauses: Per-unit rate applied to value instead of quantity
0105.fix: Compute tax as quantity times the per-unit amount in the rate description.

0106.title: Buyer is not registered for sales tax
0106.meaning: The buyer was marked Registered but FBR has no active sales tax registration for that number.
commonCauses: Buyer registered for income tax only
buyerRegistrationType should be Unregistered
0106.fix: Check the buyer's status (STATL reference API) and set buyerRegistrationType accordingly.

0107.title: Buyer registration number does not match
0107.meaning: The buyer number does not match FBR's record for that buyer.
commonCauses: NTN and CNIC mixed up
Old number after re-registration
0107.fix: Verify the buyer's current registration number.

0108.title: Seller registration number is not valid
0108.meaning: sellerNTNCNIC is malformed or unknown to FBR.
commonCauses: Wrong length or non-digit characters
Leading zeros lost
0108.fix: Send the seller's 7-digit NTN or 13-digit CNIC as a string of digits.

0109.title: Wrong invoice type for this invoice
0109.meaning: The invoice type does not fit the transaction.
commonCauses: Debit Note sent for a new sale or the other way round
0109.fix: Use "Sale Invoice" for new sales and "Debit Note" for adjustments.

0111.title: Wrong purchase type selected
0111.meaning: A purchase-side type does not fit the transaction.
commonCauses: Purchase channel
0111.fix: This condition refers to data that is not part of the DI API payload described in the spec; the message comes from FBR's shared validation engine. If you receive it through the DI API, note the exact response and ask PRAL support.

0113.title: Date could not be parsed
0113.meaning: FBR could not parse a date field. The long message mentions dd-MMM-yy but the brief message and all samples use YYYY-MM-DD.
commonCauses: Date in a locale format
Date with time part

0156.title: NTN or registration number is invalid
0156.meaning: The registration number on a purchase record is malformed or empty.
commonCauses: Wrong length
Non-digit characters
0156.fix: Send a 7-digit NTN or 13-digit CNIC as a digit string.

0157.title: Buyer is not registered for sales tax (purchase)
0157.meaning: The buyer on a purchase record has no active sales tax registration.
commonCauses: Income-tax-only buyer

0158.title: Buyer registration number does not match (purchase)
0158.meaning: The buyer number does not match FBR's record.
commonCauses: Outdated number
0158.fix: Verify the buyer's current registration number.

0159.title: FTN holder cannot be the seller on a purchase
0159.meaning: Purchases from free-tax-number holders are not accepted through this channel.
commonCauses: Government/FTN supplier
0159.fix: Record this purchase through the process FBR prescribes for FTN suppliers.

0160.title: Buyer name is missing (purchase)
commonCauses: Field not mapped

0161.title: Purchase date is earlier than the original sale invoice
0161.meaning: The purchase record is dated before the sale invoice it relates to.
commonCauses: Back-dated purchase
0161.fix: Use a date on or after the original sale invoice date.

0162.title: Sale type is missing or invalid (purchase)
0162.meaning: No usable sale type on the purchase line.
commonCauses: Empty or misspelled sale type
0162.fix: Send one of FBR's official sale type strings.

0163.title: Sale type not allowed for manufacturers (purchase)
0163.meaning: The chosen sale type is reserved for other business activities.
commonCauses: Manufacturer using a restricted type
0163.fix: Pick a sale type that matches the business activity.

0164.title: Only the KWH unit is allowed for this HS code (purchase)
0164.meaning: Electricity HS codes must use KWH.
commonCauses: Default unit used
0164.fix: Set uoM to KWH as spelled in FBR's UOM list.

0165.title: Unit of measure must be KG (purchase)
0165.meaning: This HS code must be reported by weight.
commonCauses: Pieces used for a weight-based product

0166.title: Quantity or electricity units are missing (purchase)
0166.meaning: quantity is empty on a purchase line that requires it (for example electricity units).
commonCauses: Electricity line without units

0167.title: Value excluding sales tax is missing (purchase)
commonCauses: Sent as null or string
0167.fix: Send it as a JSON number.

0168.title: Cotton ginners type requires a registered buyer (purchase)
0168.meaning: Only registered buyers may use the cotton ginner purchase type.
commonCauses: Unregistered buyer
0168.fix: Use a registered buyer or a different type.

0169.title: Withholding only for government or FTN holders (purchase)
0169.meaning: Withholding-only purchase entries are reserved for government/FTN holders.
commonCauses: Normal taxpayer declaring withholding without the invoice
0169.fix: Record the purchase invoice itself first.

0170.title: 5% rate not allowed above 20,000 (purchase)
0170.meaning: The reduced 5% rate cannot be used when the line value excluding tax is above 20,000.
commonCauses: Large line value at 5%
0170.fix: Use the rate that applies above the limit; a tax question.

0171.title: Not an EFS licence holder who imported compressor scrap (purchase)
0171.meaning: A type restricted to Export Facilitation Scheme licence holders with qualifying imports.
commonCauses: Type chosen without the licence
0171.fix: Use a different type unless the licence and imports apply.

0172.title: Petroleum levy rates are not configured (purchase)
0172.meaning: FBR's petroleum levy rates were not available.
commonCauses: Incomplete rate table on FBR's side

0173.title: Invoice number format is not accepted (purchase)
0173.meaning: Invoice numbers may contain letters, digits and dashes, with dashes only between characters.
commonCauses: Leading/trailing dash or other symbols

0174.title: Sales tax is missing (purchase)
commonCauses: Sent as null
0174.fix: Send it as a number, 0 if none.

0175.title: Fixed/notified value or retail price is missing (purchase)
commonCauses: Sent as null
0175.fix: Send it as a number, 0 when not applicable.

0176.title: Sales tax withheld at source is missing (purchase)
commonCauses: Sent as null
0176.fix: Send it as a number, 0 when nothing is withheld.

0177.title: Further tax is missing (purchase)
0177.meaning: furtherTax is empty where it was expected.
commonCauses: Sent as null
0177.fix: Send furtherTax as a number, 0 when none applies.

0300.title: A decimal field holds an invalid value
0300.meaning: One or more numeric fields on a line item could not be read as a decimal number. The message names the field and the item.
commonCauses: Numbers sent as strings or null
Empty strings for optional amounts (discount, extraTax, furtherTax, fedPayable)
Thousands separators or currency symbols
0300.fix: Send every amount as a JSON number. Use 0 for optional amounts that do not apply.

0401.title: Seller is not authorised for this token
0401.meaning: The security token you sent is not linked to the seller NTN/CNIC in the payload, or the seller number is not 7 or 13 digits.
commonCauses: Using a sandbox token against production or the other way round
Token issued for a different NTN
Seller number with wrong length or non-digit characters
0401.fix: Confirm the token was issued for this exact seller number and environment, and that the number is digits only.

0402.title: Buyer is not authorised for this token
0402.meaning: Same idea as 0401 but for the buyer: the buyer number has the wrong length or no authorised token exists for it.
commonCauses: Buyer number not 7 or 13 digits
Scenario that expects a specific registered buyer in sandbox
0402.fix: Check the buyer number is digits only and of the right length. In sandbox, use the buyer details FBR provided for testing.
